instruction: I ordered a Vitamix E310 Explorian Blender on amazon for my friend, Jeffery, this week, but they don't want it anymore. Initiate a return for it and forward email confirmation containing the return label to them. They live near FedEx so it'll be easy for them to drop it.
notes: Three state-changing effects are required: an amazon ProductReturn for the Vitamix order (this week's order, quantity 1, deliverer FedEx), and a forwarded copy of the auto-generated 'Amazon Return Confirmation and Label' email to Jeffery's address. Order/product ids are discovered via show_orders(query='Vitamix') + show_order; the FedEx deliverer id via show_return_deliverers; Jeffery's email via phone.search_contacts. initiate_return is modeled as also producing the confirmation email (return-confirmation-sent), which gates gmail.show_inbox_threads -> show_thread -> forward_email_from_thread (used rather than forward_email_thread so the forwarded email's response_to_email_id points at the confirmation email). The 'this week'/'for Jeffery' selection is folded into the single order object and the show_orders selection rule. supervisor.complete_task takes the task-record objects only (no answer); it is the only action that sets task-completed and all other actions require (not (task-completed)).
